leadText:
Make You Shine is the ending theme for the Korean dub of the Terastal Debut arc and the second of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing By Your Side. It uses the same animation as its corresponding Japanese ending theme, Let me battle. The full version of the song was released as a digital single on October 15, 2024. The song was uploaded to the official Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on January 8, 2025.

An English version of the song, titled Make You Shine (English Ver.) is the ending theme for the English and locally dubbed releases of Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua in certain Asian regions where The Pokémon Company has distribution rights. It debuted in Welcome to Naranja Academy!, replacing the instrumental version of Becoming Me in the English and Indonesian dubs and RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~ in the Taiwanese Mandarin, Hong Kong Cantonese, and Thai dubs. The full version of the song was released as a digital single on March 28, 2025.

Make You Shine is the ending theme for the Korean dub of the Terastal Debut arc and the second of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing By Your Side. It uses the same animation as its corresponding Japanese ending theme, Let me battle. The full version of the song was released as a digital single on October 15, 2024. The song was uploaded to the official Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on January 8, 2025.

An English version of the song, titled Make You Shine (English Ver.) is the ending theme for the English and locally dubbed releases of Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua in certain Asian regions where The Pokémon Company has distribution rights. It debuted in Welcome to Naranja Academy!, replacing the instrumental version of Becoming Me in the English and Indonesian dubs and RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~ in the Taiwanese Mandarin, Hong Kong Cantonese, and Thai dubs. The full version of the song was released as a digital single on March 28, 2025.

==Ending animation==
===Synopsis===
The ending song starts with a countdown seen over a Poké Ball. This is followed by quick snapshots of Liko, Roy, and Dot with their Pokémon. Liko and Roy are then seen battling with Floragato and Fuecoco respectively. The scene then changes to a moving bar on the right side showing stills of Liko commanding Hatenna and Floragato to use moves. In a similar fashion, the bar moves to show Roy with Fuecoco and Wattrel, followed by Dot with Tinkatink and Quaxly, Friede with Captain Pikachu and Charizard, then and . The bar moves to the left and showcases Katy and , followed by Brassius and , Iono and , Rika and , Poppy and , and then Hassel and .

The scene then changes to show Coral with , followed by Sidian and , and Chalce and , before then panning passed all three. The next scene shows Liko looking down, before she looks up and opens her blue eyes. 

Another countdown is then seen over a Tera Orb. The orbs burst with Terastal energy, and Tera Jewels make up the background as silhouettes of Liko, Roy, Dot, and Friede successively minimize towards the center. Various other silhouettes then pass by. 

The next scene shows darkened silhouettes of Liko, Roy, and Dot with their first partner Pokémon walking as the background changes to various regions of Paldea. and silhouettes also pass by quickly. Next, scenes of Liko with Floragato, Roy with Fuecoco and Dot with Quaxly are shown. The three then look up at the starry sky. The camera moves up to the night sky as the series logo appears.

aiReadySummary.title: Make You Shine
aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Make You Shine
Category:Korean ending themes
Make You Shine is the ending theme for the Korean dub of the Terastal Debut arc and the second of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing By Your Side. It uses the same animation as its corresponding Japanese ending theme, Let me battle. The full version of the song was released as a digital single on October 15, 2024. The song was uploaded to the official Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on January 8, 2025.

An English version of the song, titled Make You Shine (English Ver.) is the ending theme for the English and locally dubbed releases of Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua in certain Asian regions where The Pokémon Company has distribution rights. It debuted in Welcome to Naranja Academy!, replacing the instrumental version of Becoming Me in the English and Indonesian dubs and RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~ in the Taiwanese Mandarin, Hong Kong Cantonese, and Thai dubs. The full version of the song was released as a digital single on March 28, 2025.
